messages:
jordan: quick thread — routing + auth stamping issue causing wrong quota attribution for proxy-exchanged service tokens. TL;DR: when tokens are minted via the proxy exchange flow they sometimes drop the project claim and end up attributing to org-default project. Repro steps below.

nia: ok can you paste a repro / sample request? :eyes:

jordan: sure — simplified curl we used in prod test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer svc.exchange.token" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For-Origin: proxy.example" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org_123" \
  -d '{"input": "hi"}'
```
response headers show no x-project-claim, runtime falls back to org default project (project_none) and billing/quotas consume that bucket.

samir: this will bite Dedicated customers who pin quotas by project. If the exchange path loses the claim we silently move usage. We need either a strict reject or a graceful fallback with telemetry. :thinking:

lee: console UX: we should surface both the effective project and the origin (exchange vs direct). Token details need a small footnote that says "derived attribution: exchange fallback" so support can triage quickly.

jordan: proposed short-term plan: 1) patch proxy to preserve origin_project header when present, 2) emit telemetry event when attribution fallback occurs, 3) surface fallback in console token detail + add a dashboard filter, 4) canary rollout to 5% traffic then ramp. Longer-term: make exchange include explicit project claim in token minting flow.

nia: telemetry specifics: add metric `auth.attribution.fallback.count` with tags {route, proxy_type, org_id} and a sampled debug log (1% request bodies sanitized) for correlation. We can reuse existing sampling pipeline.

samir: important: billing/finance needs to know we won't retroactively reassign charges — we should ensure fallback events are tagged but not auto-bill to a different project until manual review. I'll loop in billing.

jordan: agreed — we will not backfill or rebill automatically. We'll add a boolean field `attribution_fallback=true` on the event so dashboards and billing rules can ignore or flag.

lee: UX ask: add a tiny red badge in token detail "fallback attribution" + a quick link to the KB that explains what that means and how to request a review. Also surface the `x-attribution-id` to copy for support.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2025-04-15T08:00Z -> 5% prod (auth-proxy v2.3.1).

nia: I'll open the telemetry PR and add the metric + sample policy. cc @samir for billing tag naming.

samir: sgtm. one more: include a stable correlation id in logs + response header so console can link a request -> billing event. call it `x-attribution-id` or `x-authz-correlation-id`.

jordan: good call — we'll emit `x-attribution-id` on responses and include it in telemetry and access logs.

lee: I'll draft the console copy and a small changelog entry for the release notes. also prepping a support template.

jordan: :thumbsup: opening patches now. will post PR links and canary metrics in this thread once live.

(ends)
